name: Volgatitan
isnote: Described in 2018 as a titanosaur related to Lognkosauria, but a 2026 analysis by Mannion and Carvalho recovers it in Mamenchisauridae; the placement is not settled.
sum: Volgatitan is a sauropod from the Early Cretaceous of Ulyanovsk Oblast, Russia, known from seven tail vertebrae.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Seven caudal vertebrae of a single individual; specimen number not read.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Averianov and Efimov 2018
